title: Проверка на честность и тайна Родиона  (The Honesty Test and Rodion's Secret)

scenes.title: Новая веранда и Родион Сергеевич  (The New Veranda and Rodion Sergeyevich)
scenes.summary: Andrey Mikhailovich plans a new courtyard terrace with Vika and is shocked to meet the courtyard's homeless resident, Rodion.

scenes.title: Угроза полицией и звонок Вики  (Threat of the Police and Vika's Call)
scenes.summary: Vika defends Rodion from Andrey's threats, while Max panics with Sasha in the dining room and lies to Vika on the phone.

scenes.title: Обещание никогда не врать  (The Promise Never to Lie)
scenes.summary: Sasha laughs at Max for thinking the baby is his, and Vika makes Max promise never to lie to her again.

scenes.title: Спор о влиянии Нагиева  (The Bet About Nagiyev's Influence)
scenes.summary: Katya denies any romance with Max to Eva, and Chef Barinov challenges Nagiyev to protect Rodion from Andrey Mikhailovich.

scenes.title: Кто здесь торгует лицом  (Who Is Just the Face Here)
scenes.summary: Andrey Mikhailovich refuses Nagiyev's request to keep Rodion and orders Nagiyev to entertain visiting investors.

scenes.title: Тост за честность  (A Toast to Honesty)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev pays Rodion a small bill to stay away for two days, while Vika and Max toast to honesty on their date.

scenes.title: Проверка телефонным номером  (The Phone Number Test)
scenes.summary: A stranger slips Max her phone number while Vika is away, and Vika reveals she staged it to test Max's honesty.

scenes.title: Португальский портвейн и полиция  (Portuguese Port Wine and the Police)
scenes.summary: Rodion admits he spent Nagiyev's money on Portuguese port wine just as Andrey arrives with the police to remove him.

scenes.title: Новый сотрудник кухни  (The New Kitchen Employee)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov hires Rodion as a cook to save him from the police, while Max suspects Vika is using Eva to test him again.

scenes.title: Игра в шпионов и документы  (Playing Spies and the Documents)
scenes.summary: Eva flirts with Max at the bar, convincing him she is Vika's spy, while Rodion arrives with his new documents.

scenes.title: Однофамилец Баринов  (Namesake Barinov)
scenes.summary: Rodion's new passport bears the surname Barinov, and Andrey challenges him to cook a French dish to prove his skill.

scenes.title: Мастерство Родиона и приглашение Еве  (Rodion's Mastery and the Invitation to Eva)
scenes.summary: Rodion cooks the French order like a master chef, while Max invites Eva to his apartment to spring a trap on Vika.

scenes.title: Руки помнят  (The Hands Remember)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov celebrates Rodion's cooking over whiskey, and Max invites Vika to his apartment for the evening.

scenes.title: Забытый базилик и встреча друзей  (The Forgotten Basil and Reunion of Friends)
scenes.summary: Rodion runs into the dining room with basil for the lamb and is recognized by the investor as missing millionaire Rodion Gromov.

scenes.title: Миллионер Громов и вечер у Макса  (Millionaire Gromov and Evening at Max's)
scenes.summary: Investor Denis walks out on Andrey over Rodion Gromov, while Eva flirts with Max at his apartment.

scenes.title: Никакой проверки не было  (There Was No Test)
scenes.summary: Vika finds Eva at Max's apartment, and Max's plan backfires when Vika reveals she never asked Eva to test him.

scenes.title: Верь мне, пожалуйста  (Believe Me, Please)
scenes.summary: An embarrassed Eva leaves the apartment, and Max begs Vika to forgive his paranoia and trust him.

scenes.title: Возвращение господина Громова  (The Return of Mr. Gromov)
scenes.summary: Vika forgives Max and promises to trust him, and the next day Rodion returns in an armored limousine with his wife.

scenes.title: Прощание Родиона и решение Кати  (Rodion's Farewell and Katya's Decision)
scenes.summary: Rodion and his wife thank Chef Barinov and say goodbye, prompting Katya to suddenly hand in her resignation.

scenes.title: Раскрытая тайна поцелуя  (The Kiss Secret Exposed)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov angrily reveals that he saw Max kissing Katya three days ago, shattering Vika's trust as she overhears.
